question.question_text: Tables Client(ClientID, ClientName, ContactNumber) and Job(JobID, ClientID, LeadName, Priority) are provided. Construct SQL to return client names and contact numbers for High-priority jobs led by Mira Sen. Repeated rows are permitted.
